protocol.dtype: native BF16 backbone / FP32 predictor and correction
protocol.state: embedding and layer-written states, before final norm
protocol.scoring: all valid cached next-token labels, including the last target of each window
protocol.branch_causal: same formula on output minus R mix (dense: output minus incoming state)
protocol.skip_bypass: identity layer, original indexed source slot remains readable
protocol.skip_drop_source: bypass plus zero coefficients to skipped source in every downstream Q/K/V/R mix; no reindexing or renormalization
protocol.replay: effective Q/K/V/R coefficients from unperturbed forward; external predictor always sees the unchanged input
protocol.lens: final native norm/head on layer-written state; not a unique next-consumer Q/K/V input
protocol.scope: native-checkpoint diagnostics adapted from DepthBench, not official matched-budget depth scaling
